page_title: RAY 1-0 GET | Rayo Vallecano v Getafe 02/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+3' The referee allows time for a substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez will be replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).

90+2' What a chance that is! Luis Milla (Getafe) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

89' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Carles Perez (Getafe) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
86' The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Here is a change. Alvaro Garcia is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
84' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Unai Lopez.
83' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Dani Cardenas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
80' Victor Garcia interrupts the game and punishes the behaviour of Djene (Getafe) with a red card.
80' Djene (Getafe) is booked for saying more than Victor Garcia was willing to tolerate.
77' Tempers flare after Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
75' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bertug Yildirim departs the field of play to be replaced by Peter Federico (Getafe).
72' Carles Perez (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
71' The attendance for today's match is 11648.
69' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Adrian Embarba.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jorge de Frutos as he is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
65' A pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Carles Perez (Getafe) is replacing Juan Bernat.

61' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria pulls off an easy save.
60' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
59' None of the Getafe players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
55' A yellow card for a tackle by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). Victor Garcia doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
55' Problems for Inigo Perez as Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Oscar Valentin replaces him.
54' Looks like Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
53' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria was alert and made an astonishing save!
53' Rayo Vallecano quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
49' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.

48' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. David Soria makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
46' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

44' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
43' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
39' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

38' Luis Milla sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Bertug Yildirim (Getafe), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
37' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Luis Milla (Getafe).

34' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
32' Victor Garcia shows the yellow card to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
29' The linesman signals that Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
26' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
26' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
25' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
24' Ball possession – 66:34.

19' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.

15' Good chance! Ramon Terrats (Getafe) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
12' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' 1 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Isi Palazon and Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 1:0.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
7' The ball is cleared after Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
6' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

5' Juan Bernat (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
4' Rough tackle by Bertug Yildirim (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and signals a foul after Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) brought his opponent down.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Victor Garcia will supervise the game today.
